verdict.rationale: monday.com claims generic 2-way sync between its products and "any platform you work with," and it has a GitHub/GitLab integration. However, that integration is documented only for linking pull requests to items, not for bi-directionally syncing tasks with repository issues. Missing for 10: documented two-way GitHub/GitLab issue sync (field mapping, status and comment propagation), any repo-issue-specific sync documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data

citations.quote: Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.
Link pull requests from GitHub or GitLab directly to their related items in monday.com so teams can quickly access code and updates in context.
